scope: Exact ordinary official image URLs already recorded in tracked repository UTF-8 files. New continuation package excluded. No network requests.

repository_snapshot.path_selection: git ls-files -z; tracked paths only; working-tree UTF-8 contents scanned

status: Historical recorded URL inventory only; no current access, transcription completeness, or solve-status assertion.

historical_collection_assertion.status: Historical assertion in repository prose; distinct from this inventory’s actually observed records; not independently verified here.

limitations: This is not a full HCPortal catalogue and does not establish a complete Anna Tichá corpus.
Only literal URLs matching the declared case-sensitive pattern were collected; escaped, assembled, relative, lowercase-extension, or other media URL forms are outside scope.
CARD is taken only from the explicit filename in a recorded URL; media IDs are never calculated or inferred.
Catalogue IDs are extracted only from exact crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/ID links in matching tracked anna-ticha/card-N.md files. Missing catalogue IDs remain missing.
Duplicate URL mentions are combined while preserving evidence file and line lists. A recorded mention is not proof that the URL currently resolves.
No new handoff URLs were added. The new continuation package and all untracked files were excluded to avoid circular inventory growth.
No source image/PDF bytes, private email, or private filesystem paths are included.
